results.releaseNotes:
• NEW: MIDI Out. SUPER 606 can now send its patterns, drum pads, or its individual drum hits to your DAW or anything that can receive MIDI!
• FIXED: AUv3 state now saves and restores correctly in GarageBand and Logic Pro
• FIXED: The first beat no longer drops in GarageBand when Count-In is on.

• MIDI Out has three modes. Set it on the About page. 
The MIDI Out setting is saved with each preset and with the AUv3 state.

1. "Drum Notes" MIDI Out
Sends every drum hit as a MIDI note.
Note: if your DAW plays those notes back into SUPER 606 while its internal pattern is also running, you will hear doubled hits. 

To avoid that, do one of the following:
• Loop SUPER 606 on an empty pattern
• Send note #33 (A0), Transport Stop, before the DAW plays its notes, so the internal pattern stays stopped
• Use Pattern MIDI Out instead

2. "Pattern Changes" MIDI Out
The most authentic groove: SUPER 606 plays its own patterns and your DAW triggers the pattern changes. That way, the internal groove engine can do its thing and you keep more of that little timing magic and mojo.
Pattern changes: notes 24–31 (C0–G0)
Modes 1 & 2 both send Drum Pad MIDI as well.

3. MIDI Out Off: both buttons toggled off.
---
GARAGEBAND for iOS
GarageBand records MIDI Out with no extra setup. 
Plus you can easily turn that MIDI into audio inside GarageBand, choose "Merge" on the 606 track.

LOGIC PRO for iPad
Logic records a plug-in's MIDI onto a second track, not the 606 track. Add a second software instrument track and select it. Open the Inspector (second icon at the bottom left, two stacked horizontal faders). Set "Internal MIDI In" to "Instrument Output" and choose 606 Drums. Set Record to Internal MIDI In. Record-enable the second track and press Record.

Not a Logic power user? It is often easier to export MIDI or Audio with one tap in the app: use the Share icon at the top, second from the right.

And remember to avoid double hits.
results.description:
CLASSIC DRUM MACHINE 
*Roland Cloud and TR-606 are trademarks of Roland Corporation. SUPER 606 is not affiliated with or endorsed by Roland Corporation. 

"Fun and Instantly Inspiring!" — The GarageBand Guide
"Authentic, all-synthesis-based TR-606 emulation for iOS” — Synth Anatomy

"ICONIC... SUPER 606 Drums DESERVES a spot on your iPhone or iPad!" —  Beat Community Blog

"I have the Roland Cloud TR-606 as a plugin, and I compared them. There are no significant, audible differences. In my opinion, SUPER 606 nailed them in this comparison. — Synth Anatomy

Give your music movement and life! 

LIKE EXPENSIVE HARDWARE:
• TAP Your Beat: Drum Pad pattern recording with accent/dull toggle
• MULTI-OUTPUTS available for each Drum track in AUv3 mode
• FLAMS: All nine 606-style types, plus a traditional ahead-of-the-beat Flam mode
• HARDWARE-inspired down to the details: Advanced 606 features, and thoughtful touches throughout.
• ANALOG dials in variations, including analog pitch drift and humanization
• LAST STEP for each track, create evolving Polyrhythms

WATCH VIDEO:
audiokitpro.com/super606

"INCREDIBLE, Get this App!" — Jade Starr Youtube

PRO-FEATURES:
• CLOCK SYNC: MIDI Clock, Ableton Link, AUv3, or Internal
• MPC-STYLE SWING, Inspired by Roger Linn
• RATCHETS: 606-style Substeps in 2x, 3x, and 4x 
• Triplets/beat divisions. Make 3/4 timing the classic way!
• XL KICK mode: More melodic, Beefier "608" Kick Mode

Together, they make SUPER 606 feel alive. 

EASY WORKFLOW! ONE-TAP EXPORT:
• Export MIDI for current pattern or the full sequence with one button
• Export STEMS for easy professional mixing and sharing
• Export WAV Loops, with or without FX Tails

MAGIC PATTERN GENERATOR:
Tap it and start making unlimited drum patterns. 
• MAGIC PRESET MAKER creates a cohesive sound, FX profile, groove, and tempo
• SMART FILLS button analyzes your current beat and creates a fill that fits
No prompts, no shared data, no cloud generation. Everything runs on your device.

INSPIRING FX: 
• DELAY: Hardware 606-style delay, with per-drum routing
• HEAT: Overdrive fine-tuned for a drum machine, hats/cymbals remain musical
• REVERB: Epic Reverb with lo-cut, per-drum routing
• FILTER: Moog-Inspired 
• MANGLE: Crusher with lo-end bypass

MORE:
In addition to EXPORT options above:
• RECORD standalone performances directly to WAV. SUPER 606 captures your performances. No other apps required. 
• IMPORT MIDI from your DAW and edit your beats on the go!
• AUv3 WORKFLOW: Full Mobile host transport sync, complete state recall, a stereo main mix, and eight individual drum outputs.
• Includes Standalone iPhone, iPad, and mobile AUv3 versions for one low price. 

INDEPENDENT SEQUENCE MANAGEMENT:
• Save and organize sequences independently from sound presets
• Import MIDI or SUPER 606 formats into Sequence banks
• Custom banks, favorites, search, and sharing

MORE: 
• Eight chain-able A–H patterns per sequence, inspired by the Hardware
• Per-track Swing: Every drum can have its own Swing settings!
• Per-step normal, ghost/dull, and accent levels
• Four rhythmic grid modes: 16th notes, 32nd notes, 8th-note triplets, 16th-note triplets. 
• 16th and 32nd notes in same screen. Ie. Hi-Hats 32nd notes while Snare 16th.
• Control app with MIDI + MIDI Learn 

OPEN-SOURCE:
Get the free new XL 606 Kick Drum, Snare, Clap, Toms, Hi-Hat code:
https://github.com/analogcode/606-Inspired-Synth-Drums

Yes, we're giving away the secret sauce. Make your own 606 drum machine!

SUPER 606 is an independent original instrument inspired by classic drum synthesis and sequencing workflows. It is not affiliated with, authorized, sponsored, or endorsed by Roland Corporation. All other trademarks are the property of their respective owners.
** RD-6, etc are trademarks or registered trademarks of Behringer. SUPER 606 is not affiliated with or endorsed by Behringer.

results.releaseNotes:
THANKS EVERYONE, This app will keep getting better!
• NEW: Preset Bank by Bri Kup
• UI: Improved contrast between ON/OFF toggles for Reverb, Delay, etc
• FIXED: Plot display could freeze in AUM
• SEQUENCER: You can now press and drag across a row to quickly change multiple steps. If the first step you touch is OFF, dragging turns steps OFF. If it’s ON, dragging turns them ON.

GUESS WHAT? MIDI OUT is coming soon!

PRO TIP:
For the most authentic groove, use the patterns inside the app and trigger pattern changes and transport with MIDI, rather than driving every drum hit with individual MIDI notes.

Pattern changes start at MIDI note #24 (C0–G0), with Start/Stop on G#0 and A0.
You can also assign MIDI CCs to pattern changes and transport Start/Stop!

That way, the internal groove engine can do its thing and you keep more of that little timing magic and mojo.
